scenes.text: Every night ends in a "one more game" argument? Let the settings be the bad guy.

scenes.title: Set a limit on the console itself.
scenes.body: **Most consoles have family settings** for daily play time.

scenes.title: Match it on phone and tablet.
Give a 10-minute warning.
scenes.body: So they can **finish the round** instead of rage-quitting.

scenes.title: Agree on the rule once, out loud.
scenes.body: Then **the timer enforces it** — not you.
